content_of_post_to_comment: Substack’s feed algorithm is too swingy. I will like an artwork and suddenly my feed is all artworks. I will subscribe to a guy from India (not even talking about India!) and then get a feed full of posts about India. I will like one article about the history of Origenism and suddenly my entire feed is theology bros. I will like an article about OCD and suddenly my entire feed is Tiktok therapyspeak slop. And it's not just some inclusions, in each case it became most of the feed. It feels like Substack is trying to make me into a legible type of guy so it can serve me content. I hate it.
comment: The interesting tension is that personalization needs a model of you, but identity itself is fluid. The algorithm mistakes temporary curiosity for a stable category, turning exploration into a trap.
